items.title: Navy's Fleet Air Arm: From tracking enemy radars in 1965 to monitoring China along LAC
items.author: DHRUV YADAV
items.description: The Indian Navy's Fleet Air Arm has historically supported land operations through naval aviation. Its contribution dates back to the 1965 war, where reconnaissance aircraft identified enemy radar installations. Live feeds from these aircraft aid the Army in monitoring troop movements and strengthening joint operations.
